purpose: Frozen world/joint coordinate conventions, structural ROM envelope and analytic forward-kinematics sign probes.

decisions.value: unconstrained planar base: root_tx, root_tz, root_ry with zero stiffness, zero damping, zero armature and no positional catch; NOT a 6-DOF free root
decisions.notes: Lateral translation, roll and yaw are structurally removed; removed DOFs must never be called 'free'.

value.semantic: TRUNK_PELVIS_SAGITTAL_HINGE (legacy code name 'lumbar' permitted only with this semantic exposed)

decisions.locator: aggregate reduced-model trunk-pelvis flexion-extension; not a literal lumbar-spine joint
decisions.sensitivity: sensitivity on the reduced bound is part of the strategy-envelope study, not a calibration to exceed
decisions.notes: Explicit reduced-model engineering bound; must not be presented as measured lumbar ROM.
Structural capability bound, not a technique target.
No nominal hyperextension; reverse-knee geometry is structurally impossible under the V3 coordinate authority.

decisions.locator: weight-bearing dorsiflexion ~39-45 deg; soccer jump-landing peaks ~32-38 deg
decisions.notes: The former +20 deg dorsiflexion cap is withdrawn as too restrictive for a structural human envelope.
Negative is plantarflexion; positive is toe dorsiflexion.

value.trunk_pelvis: + about +y = forward trunk flexion relative to pelvis
value.knee: axis +y, +q = knee flexion (ankle moves posteriorly relative to knee)

decisions.locator: system authority section 5; deterministic FK derivation
decisions.notes: Propulsion must reduce hip/knee flexion, drive ankle negative (plantarflexion) and permit positive MTP dorsiflexion in the forefoot/toe rocker.

decisions.statement: Analytic FK sign probes (mandatory deterministic validation).

value.root_ry_probe: root_ry = +10 deg with all joints zero: a point initially on +z above the root moves to +x by L*sin(10 deg); COM x increases
value.hip_probe: hip = +10 deg (axis -y): knee joint x increases by L_thigh*sin(10 deg) (anterior)
value.knee_probe: knee = +10 deg (axis +y): ankle joint x decreases by L_shank*sin(10 deg) (posterior)
value.ankle_probe: ankle = +10 deg (axis -y): toe-tip z increases by L_foot*cos(ankle_rest)*sin(10 deg) (dorsiflexion)
value.mtp_probe: mtp = +10 deg (axis -y): toe-tip z increases relative to the forefoot (dorsiflexion)
value.trunk_probe: trunk_pelvis hinge = +10 deg about +y: head/vertex x increases by L_MIDH_vertex*sin(10 deg) (forward flexion)
value.root_tx_probe: root_tx = +0.01 m: all body x coordinates increase by 0.01 m exactly
value.root_tz_probe: root_tz = +0.01 m: all body z coordinates increase by 0.01 m exactly

decisions.locator: analytic forward kinematics of the frozen topology
decisions.notes: RES-83 must implement these probes as tests; any sign disagreement is a build failure, not a tuning problem.

decisions.statement: ROM values are capability bounds, not targets.
decisions.value: no controller may chase a structural limit; joint-limit hits and saturated-limit dwell are telemetry warnings
